syllabus_topics: Introduction: Concepts of Mass and Force; Action and Reaction; External Forces.

Statics of Rigid Bodies: Moment of a Force with respect to a Point and an Axis; Moment of a Couple; Equivalent Systems of Forces; Equilibrium of a Rigid Body in Two and Three Dimensions; Distributed Loads on Beams.
Trusses: Simple and Space Trusses; Methods of Joints and Sections; Joints subject to Special Loading Conditions.

Structures and Machines: Structures that cease to be rigid when separated from their supports; Friction. Principle of Virtual Work: Real Machines; Work of a Force; Potential Energy and Equilibrium; Stability.
Geometry of Masses: Center of Mass; Area and Inertia Moments; Inertia Tensor.

Kinematics of Rigid Bodies: Rotation; Plane Motion; Instantaneous Center of Rotation; Absolute and Relative Acceleration; General Motion; Motion of a Particle in Three Dimensions relative to a Rotating Axis System.
bibliography: F.P. Beer, E.R. Johnston Jr., D. Mazurek, Vector Mechanics for Engineers: Statics, McGraw-Hill Education, 2018 (main)
J.L. Meriam, L.G. Kraige, J.N. Bolton, Engineering Mechanics: Statics, Wiley, 2020 (secondary)
R.C. Hibbeler, Engineering Mechanics: Statics & Dynamics, Pearson, 2015 (secondary)
